report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms latency and p95 ~98ms; no errors, timeouts, or pool saturation appear in current evidence. The alert does not establish an anomaly, so no root-cause candidate is substantiated. Additional latency baseline and dependency/pool telemetry are required before attributing a cause.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency/error baseline for /v1/checkout over a longer window to confirm whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Downstream dependency latency (order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres) to test downstream-latency or redis-timeout
DB connection pool saturation metrics (wait time, active vs max) to test db-pool-exhaustion
Error/exception logs or non-200 statuses to test http-500 or bad-configuration
